name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text:
**Decision:** Add a **bold, full-width focus ring** (4px, 2:1 contrast ratio) on all focusable elements in EXCAVA.

This maximizes visibility for keyboard users, especially on low-contrast backgrounds, without relying on color alone. The trade-off is slightly more visual noise, but it’s necessary for users who navigate exclusively by keyboard.

name: Reader
text: **Risk:** A bold, full-width ring creates a "siren effect" for keyboard users—it’s visually overwhelming and breaks the flow of scanning content. **Alternative:** Use a subtle 2px ring with a 3:1 contrast ratio, only on the element’s border (not full-width), paired with a visible focus indicator on hover/focus states. **Settle it:** Test both with 5 keyboard users—if the bold ring causes hesitation or fatigue, switch to the subtle version.
